title: Chamanzar2020: Ultra high-density EEG of interictal migraine and controls during visual, auditory stimulation and rest
description: Ultra high-density 128-channel EEG recorded from 18 individuals with migraine (interictal) and 21 healthy controls. Recordings include steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) and steady-state auditory evoked potential (SSAEP) tasks at 4 and 6 Hz, as well as eyes-open resting state. The data support analyses of cortical coherence abnormalities in migraine.
methods_description: Recorded with a 128-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz (24-bit) using a custom ultra-high-density cap (~14 mm spacing) over occipital, parietal and frontal areas, inside a Faraday cage. Tasks comprised flickering vertical gratings (SSVEP), amplitude-modulated 1 kHz tones (SSAEP) and eyes-open rest with a fixation cross. Roughly 10% of trials were attention trials requiring a key press. Auxiliary channels included EOG, ECG, GSR, respiration, plethysmography and temperature.
